name: Not Paying Your Bills
overview: Scripture teaches that failing to repay debts is a mark of wickedness, contrasting with the righteousness that shows mercy and generosity (Psalms 37:21). Borrowing places one under the authority of the lender, highlighting the importance of financial faithfulness (Proverbs 22:7). God calls His people to fulfill their vows promptly, reflecting integrity before Him (Ecclesiastes 5:4), and to seek reconciliation with others when there is a debt or offense (Matthew 5:23). Ultimately, believers are commanded to owe nothing but love, which fulfills the law and honors God (Romans 13:8), grounded in the grace revealed through Christ’s sacrifice (John 3:16).
